name: Portal
description: Trace a circle in the air with your index finger to open a rotating Doctor-Strange-style portal. A held fist closes it.

name: Shapes
description: Pinch thumb and fingertip together to drop points in space. Three or more points close into a shape with a live filter rendered inside it.

name: Finger Frame
description: Hold up both hands, thumb and index forming a frame between them. A filter fills the frame live as you move it around.

name: Detection Lab
description: Multi-hand landmarks, full-body pose, face mesh, and face recognition, all running together in one live feed.

name: Gesture Mouse
description: Control your real OS cursor with hand gestures. Point to move, pinch to click and drag, hold to scroll.

name: Face Recognition
description: Recognizes a fixed set of enrolled people from your webcam feed. Run the Enroll tool first to build the gallery.

name: Enroll
description: Builds the face gallery from reference photos in data/known_faces before Face Recognition can identify anyone. Batch script -- shows its log output, not a live video feed.
